title: Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL, Fabric
description: A SQL Server database, an Azure SQL database, or a Microsoft Fabric warehouse or SQL endpoint — with a SQL login or an Entra service principal.

fields.name: auth
fields.label: Sign in with
fields.help: sql: a SQL login. entra: an Entra (Azure AD) service principal — Azure SQL and Fabric.

fields.name: user
fields.label: User
fields.help: A login that can only read (db_datareader): Superatom checks every query is a read, but SQL Server has no read-only session.

fields.name: encrypt
fields.label: Encrypt
fields.help: true (the default) unless the server has no certificate.

setup.title: Where the server is
setup.say:
The SQL Server's address as the engine reaches it — for Azure SQL or Fabric, the server name ending .database.windows.net (or the Fabric SQL endpoint).

If the server has a firewall (Azure: Networking → firewall rules), let the engine's machine in first.

setup.title: Sign in
setup.say: A SQL login, or an Entra (Azure AD) app that may read. For a SQL login, run this as an admin (choose a password, name your database):

copy.label: Make a read-only login

fix.say: Entra refused the app: check the tenant ID, the client ID and that the secret has not expired — and that the app is a user of the database (CREATE USER [app name] FROM EXTERNAL PROVIDER).
